ja529:1.1: Kassa sutvā sataṃ dammi sabassaṃ daṭṭhu Sonakaṃ, ko me Sonakam akkhāti sahāyaṃ paṃsukīlitan ti g. ā.
ja529:2.1: Atha bravī māṇavako daharo pañcacūḷako: mayhaṃ sutvā sataṃ dehi sahassaṃ daṭṭhu Sonakaṃ. ahaṃ Sonakam akkhissaṃ sahāyaṃ paṃsukīḷitan ti.
ja529:3.1: Katarasmiṃ [so] janapade raṭṭhesu nigamesu ca kattha te Sonako diṭṭho tam me akkhāhi pucchito.
ja529:4.1: Tav' eva deva vijite tav' ev' uyyānabhūmiyā ujuvaṃsā mahāsālā nīlobhāsā manoramā
ja529:5.1: Tiṭṭhanti meghasamonā rammā aññoññanissitā, tesaṃ mūlasmiṃ Sonako jhāyati anupādāno upādānesu lokesu ḍayhamānesu nibbuto.
ja529:6.1: Tato ca rājā pāyāsi senāya caturaṅgiyā, kārāpetvā samaṃ maggaṃ agamā yena Sonako.
ja529:7.1: Uyyānabhūmiṃ gantvāna vicaranto brahāvane āsīnaṃ Sonakaṃ dakkhi ḍayhamānesu nibbutan ti.
ja529:8.1: Kapaṇo vatāyaṃ bhikkhu muṇḍo saṃghāṭipāruto amātiko apītiko rukkhamūlasmiṃ jhāyatīti.
ja529:9.1: Imaṃ vākyaṃ nisāmetvā Sonako etad abravi: na rāja kapaṇo hoti dhammaṃ kāyena phassayaṃ.
ja529:10.1: Yo ca dhammaṃ niraṃkatvā adhammaṃ anuvattati sa rājā kapaṇo hoti pāpo pāpaparāyano ti.
ja529:11.1: Arindamo ti me nāmaṃ, Kāsirājā ti maṃ vidū, kacci bhoto sukhā seyyā idha pattassa Sonakā 'ti g. ā.
ja529:12.1: Sadāpi bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: na tesaṃ koṭṭhe upenti na kumbhe na kaḷopiyā, paraniṭṭhitam esānā tena yāpenti subbatā.
ja529:13.1: Dutiyam pi bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: anavajjo piṇḍo bhottabbo na ca koc' ūparodhati.
ja529:14.1: Tatiyam pi bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: nibbuto piṇḍo bhottabbo na ca koc' ūparodhati.
ja529:15.1: Catuttham bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: muttassa raṭṭhe carato saṅgo yassa na vijjati.
ja529:16.1: Pañcamaṃ bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: nagaramhi ḍayhamānamhi nāssa kiñci aḍayhatha.
ja529:17.1: Chaṭṭhaṃ bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: raṭṭhe vilumpamānamhi nāssa kiñci ahīratha.
ja529:18.1: Sattamaṃ bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: corehi rakkhitaṃ maggaṃ ye c' aññe pāripanthikā pattacīvaram ādāya sotthiṃ gacchanti subbatā.
ja529:19.1: Aṭṭhamaṃ bhadram adhanassa anāgārassa bhikkhuno: yaṃ yaṃ disaṃ pakkamati anapekho va gacchatīti.
ja529:20.1: Bahū pi bhadrakā ete yo tvaṃ bhikkhu pasaṃsasi, ahañ ca giddho kāmesu kathaṃ kāhāmi Sonaka.
ja529:21.1: Piyā me mānusā kāmā atho divyāpi me piyā, atha kena nu vaṇṇena ubho loke labhāmase ti.
ja529:22.1: Kāme [su] giddhā kāmaratā kāmesu adhimucchitā narā pāpāni katvāna upapajjanti duggatiṃ.
ja529:23.1: Ye ca kāme pahatvāna nikkhantā akutobhayā ekodibhāvādhigatā na te gacchanti duggatiṃ.
ja529:24.1: Upaman te karissāmi, taṃ suṇohi Arindama, upamāya p' idh' ekacce atthaṃ jānanti paṇḍitā:
ja529:25.1: Gaṅgāya kuṇapaṃ disvā vuyhamānaṃ mahaṇṇave vāyaso samacintesi appapañño acetaso:
ja529:26.1: Yānañ ca vat' idaṃ laddhaṃ bhakkho cāyaṃ anappako, tattha rattiṃ tattha divā tatth' eva nirato mano.
ja529:27.1: Khādaṃ nāgassa maṃsāni pipaṃ Bhāgīrasodakaṃ sampassaṃ vanacetyāni na palittha vihaṅgamo.
ja529:28.1: Taṃ va otaraṇī Gaṅgā pamattaṃ kuṇape rataṃ samuddaṃ ajjhagāhayi agati yattha pakkhinaṃ.
ja529:29.1: So ca bhakkhaparikkhīṇo udāpatvā vihaṅgamo na pacchato na purato n' uttaraṃ no pi dakkhiṇaṃ
ja529:30.1: Dīpaṃ so na ajjhagacchi agati yattha pakkhinaṃ, so ca tatth' eva pāpattha yathā dubbalako tathā.
ja529:31.1: Tañ ca sāmuddikā macchā kumbhīlā makarā susū pasayhakārā khādiṃsu phandamānaṃ vipakkhinaṃ.
ja529:32.1: Evam eva tuvaṃ rāja ye c' aññe kāmabhogino giddhā ce na vamissanti kākapaññāya te vidū.
ja529:33.1: Esā te upamā rāja atthasandassanī katā, tvañ ca paññāyase tena yadi kāhasi vā na vā ti.
ja529:34.1: Ekavācam pi dvevācaṃ bhaṇeyya anukampako taduttariṃ na bhāseyya dāso ayirassa santike
ja529:35.1: ti. Idaṃ vatvāna pakkāmi Sonako amitabuddhimā vehāse antalikkhasmiṃ anusāsitvāna khattiyan ti
ja529:36.1: Ko nu 'me rājakattāro sūtā veyyattim āgatā, rajjaṃ niyyādayissāmi, nāhaṃ rajjena-m-atthiko.
ja529:37.1: Ajj' eva pabbajissāmi, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, māhaṃ kāko va dummedho kāmānaṃ vasam annagā ti.
ja529:38.1: Atthi te daharo putto Dīghāvu raṭṭhavaddhano, Taṃ rajje abhisiñcassu, so no rājā bhavissatīti.
ja529:39.1: Khippaṃ kumāraṃ ānetha Dīghāvuṃ raṭṭhavaddhanaṃ, taṃ rajje abhisiñcassu, so vo rājā bhavissati.
ja529:40.1: Tato kumāraṃ ānesuṃ Dīghāvuṃ raṭṭhavaddhanaṃ, taṃ disvā ālapi rājā ekaputtaṃ manoramaṃ:
ja529:41.1: Saṭṭhi gāmasahassāni paripuññāni sabbaso -- te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te.
ja529:42.1: Ajj' eva pabbajissāmi, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve, māhaṃ kāko va dummedho kāmānaṃ vasam annagā. Saṭṭhi
ja529:44.1: Ārūḷhā gāmaṇīyehi tomaraṃkusapāṇihi -- te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te. Ajj' eva etc.
ja529:46.1: Saṭṭhi assasahassāni sabbālaṃkārabhūsitā ajānīyā va jātiyā sindhavā sīghavāhino
ja529:47.1: Ārūḷhā gāmaṇīyehi illiyācāpadhārihi -- te putta {paṭipajjassu}, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te. Ajj' eva etc.
ja529:49.1: Saṭṭhi rathasahassāni sannaddhā ussitaddhajā dīpā atho pi veyyagghā sabbālaṃkārabhūsitā
ja529:50.1: Ārūḷhā gāmaṇīyehi cāpahatthehi vammihi -- te putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te. Ajj' eva etc.
ja529:52.1: Saṭṭhi dhenusahassāni rohaññā puṅgavūsabhā -- tā putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te. Ajj' eva etc.
ja529:54.1: Soḷasitthisahassāni sabbālaṃkārabhūsitā vicitrahatthābharaṇā āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā -- tā putta paṭipajjassu, rajjaṃ niyyādayāmi te. Ajj' eva etc.
ja529:56.1: Daharass' eva me tāta mātā matā ti me sutaṃ, tayā vinā ahaṃ tāta jīvitum hi na ussahe.
ja529:57.1: Yathā āraññakaṃ nāgaṃ poto anveti pacchato jessantaṃ giriduggesu samesu visamesu ca
ja529:58.1: Evaṃ taṃ anugacchāmi pattam ādāya pacchato, subharo te bhavissāmi, na te hessāmi dubbharo.
ja529:59.1: Yathā sāmuddikaṃ nāvaṃ vāṇijānaṃ dhanesinaṃ vohāro tattha gaṇheyya vāṇijā vyasanī siyā
ja529:60.1: Evam evāyaṃ puttakali antarāyakaro mamaṃ, imaṃ kumāraṃ pāpetha pāsādaṃ rativaddhanaṃ.
ja529:61.1: Tattha kambussahatthāyo yathā Sakkaṃ va accharā tā naṃ tattha ramessanti, tāhi-m-eso ramissati.
ja529:62.1: Tato kumāraṃ pāpesuṃ pāsādaṃ rativaddhanaṃ, taṃ disvā avacuṃ kaññā Dīghāvuṃ raṭṭhaddhanaṃ:
ja529:63.1: Devatā nu si gandhabbo ādu Sakko purindado, ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ.
ja529:64.1: N' amhi devo na gandhabbo na pi Sakko purindado, Kāsirañño ahaṃ putto Dīghāvu raṭṭhavaddhano. Mama bharatha, bhaddaṃ vo, ahaṃ bhattā bhavāmi vo.
ja529:65.1: Taṃ tattha avacuṃ kaññā Dīghāvuṃ raṭṭhavaddhanaṃ: kuhiṃ rājā anuppatto, ito rājā kuhiṃ gato.
ja529:66.1: Paṃkaṃ rājā atikkanto thale rājā patiṭṭhito akaṇṭakaṃ agahanaṃ paṭipanno mahāpathaṃ.
ja529:67.1: Ahañ ca paṭipanno 'smi maggaṃ duggatigāminaṃ sakaṇṭakaṃ sagahanaṃ yena gacchāmi duggatiṃ.
ja529:68.1: Tassa te sāgataṃ rāja sīhasseva giribbajaṃ, anusāsa mahārāja, tvaṃ no sabbāsaṃ issaro ti.
